objective: Test whether broad-PIT post-filing revenue growth and operating-margin expansion create a distinct cost-aware event sleeve that can later diversify the fixed multi-sleeve lead.

data_contract.financials: Polygon /vX/reference/financials quarterly rows fetched by filing_date for 2018-2024; 125679 rows and 9343 CIKs in the frozen local cache.
data_contract.availability: Exact intraday publication time is unavailable. Entry is therefore the first trading session strictly after filing_date at exact 09:35.
data_contract.deduplication: Earliest filing per CIK, fiscal year, fiscal period, and period end. Fiscal periods are Q1-Q4 only; no inferred Q4 is manufactured.
data_contract.fundamentals: Revenue YoY compares the same fiscal period to fiscal year minus one. Operating margin is operating income divided by revenue; margin change compares the same fiscal period year over year.
data_contract.outlier_guards: Require positive current and prior revenue, abs(revenue YoY)<=300%, both margins within [-200%,200%], and abs(margin YoY change)<=100 percentage points.
data_contract.universe: Quarterly PIT market-cap top500 representative per CIK, then current daily PIT liquidity eligibility and ADV20 >= $10m. No old/manual 62 input.
data_contract.execution: 3% NAV requested per event, <=1% ADV20, no overlapping ticker position, deterministic CIK/ticker order, 1x hard gross cap with proportional same-timestamp refill, exact 09:35 entry and exact 15:55 scheduled exit.
data_contract.costs: 4 bps base and 8 bps stress per traded notional, 1% annual short borrow, 2.5% financing above 1x.

variants.name: dual_confirm_hold5
variants.rule: long revenue_yoy>=0.10 and margin_change>=0.02; short revenue_yoy<=-0.10 and margin_change<=-0.02

variants.name: dual_confirm_hold20
variants.rule: long revenue_yoy>=0.10 and margin_change>=0.02; short revenue_yoy<=-0.10 and margin_change<=-0.02

selection.rank: Higher development base Sharpe, then CAGR, then less severe DD, then variant name.

bridge_if_validation_passes: One fixed diagnostic only: 75% existing 75/25 lead net daily return plus 25% selected new sleeve base-cost return. No bridge weight search or validation reselection.
pre_result_implementation_correction: The initial execution attempts timed out before writing or printing any performance. The implementation was corrected so all variants replay only 2018-2022 for selection and only the selected row replays the full path for validation. Rules, thresholds, costs, gates, and ranking are unchanged; the corrected script was re-hashed before any result was observed.
post_result_reporting_addition: After the terminal development failure, yearly attribution and ledger-reconciliation QA outputs were added without changing data construction, trades, returns, costs, gates, ranking, or selection. Before final reporting, missingMarks aggregation was corrected from summing a cumulative engine counter to taking its maximum/final value. The script was re-hashed and all artifacts were regenerated.
